messages:
Alice (Support): Hey team — Customer reported a big billing jump tied to streaming usage yesterday. Dashboard shows ~12k tokens but invoice is ~19k. They use SSE clients and intermittently cancel/resume streams.
Ben (Customer): attaching the session id and sample logs: session=xyz-9ab, req=req_0a1b2c, times around 2026-11-23T14:12Z. We see repeated final frames after reconnects.
Raj (Eng): Thanks — do you have the raw SSE frames? curious whether client sends final [DONE] or server emits final on timeout.
Ben (Customer): pasted example frames:
```
data: {"delta":"Hello"}


data: {"delta":" world"}


event: message
data: {"done":true, "seq": 42}


# then client reconnects after network blip
data: {"delta":""}


event: message
data: {"done":true, "seq": 42}

````
Maya (SRE): I think I saw this pattern in logs: when client reconnects we sometimes replay the last partial chunk to the new connection and then also emit a separate finalize event. That could double-count tokens if billing triggers on both.
Lorenzo (Billing): Confirmed: current metering counts token usage on each chunk ingestion event. If a finalize chunk is replayed + re-finalized, both get tallied. We don't currently dedupe by (session_id, seq).
Raj (Eng): I can repro locally with an EventSource script. Repro steps: 1) open SSE; 2) stream two chunks; 3) force socket close; 4) reopen and server replays tail + sends finalize. Result: tokens increment twice in billing-log.
Alice (Support): Can you paste the curl/node repro snippet? Customer needs ETA for fix.
Raj (Eng): snippet:
```
# pseudo repro (node)
const es = new EventSource(url+"?session=xyz-9ab");
// send two data frames then kill connection
// reopen and note duplicate final frame
```
Lorenzo (Billing): Mitigation options: 1) idempotency check on billing ingest (fast, low-risk) 2) dedupe at finalization step by maintaining last_seq per session (need storage bump). I'll spike 1) first.
Alice (Support): Customer asked if we can issue invoice credit if we confirm double-bill.
Lorenzo (Billing): yes — if we validate duplicate final emission for their session we can credit the delta. I'll need logs + session id.
billing-bot: created ticket BILL-4521: "SSE reconnect causes duplicate final chunk billing" assigned to Lorenzo (Billing). link: https://redwood.example/tickets/BILL-4521
Maya (SRE): I'll add an alert to detect sudden "duplicate_final_seq" spikes in prod and a query to find affected sessions in last 48h.
Raj (Eng): Opening PR for a short-term fix: filter finalize events by (session_id, seq) before calling metering. ETA ~4h. Will attach tests and a canary rollout plan.
Alice (Support): Thanks everyone — looping in eng-runtime and billing teams to coordinate hotfix + customer credit. Will update Ben in ~6h. :+1:
